name: Netigate
description_en:
Netigate is a customer and employee experience platform combining survey collection, feedback integration, text analysis and reporting. Netigate Surveys is the questionnaire component; Insights and Digital address related analysis and digital-touchpoint work. The official pages present a broader ongoing feedback program rather than only a one-off form.

Its current positioning emphasizes EU hosting and multilingual feedback analysis. Those vendor statements are relevant procurement leads, not an automatic legal conclusion for a particular organization. The buying unit is a configured program, with capabilities and organizational scope affecting the quote.
description_zh:
Netigate 是客户与员工体验平台，组合问卷收集、反馈集成、文本分析和报告。Netigate Surveys 是问卷组件，Insights 与 Digital 处理相关分析及数字触点。官网呈现的是持续反馈项目，而不仅是一张临时表单。

当前定位强调欧盟托管和多语言反馈分析。这些厂商陈述可作为采购核查线索，不能自动形成对具体组织的法律结论。购买对象是配置后的项目，能力及组织范围影响报价。

core_features.explanation_en: Surveys provides logic, branding and email/SMS/link distribution.
core_features.explanation_zh: Surveys 提供逻辑、品牌及邮件／短信／链接分发。

core_features.explanation_en: Combines survey and other feedback signals with text and sentiment analysis.
core_features.explanation_zh: 把问卷及其他反馈信号结合到文本与情绪分析。

core_features.explanation_en: Reports and prioritized actions support assigned follow-up rather than only score collection.
core_features.explanation_zh: 报表与优先行动支持指定跟进，而不只收集分数。

en: Connect a survey trend to an owned improvement
zh: 把问卷趋势连接到有负责人的改进
use_cases.basis: Editorial task and fit judgments grounded in the attached primary sources; no observed deployment.

Research scope.en: Public documentation and commercial access reviewed; examples are proposed evaluation workflows.
Research scope.zh: 核对公开文档与商业入口；示例是建议的评估流程。

target_audience.organization_sizes_en: Select by workflow, volume and governance needs; no universal size claim.
target_audience.organization_sizes_zh: 按流程、用量与治理需求选择，不宣称适合所有规模。

steps.en: Start with one questionnaire and one decision, then list the CRM, HR or support context needed. Confirm the named connector and data permissions rather than assume all sources are included. Test survey branches, a known response and access to a shared dashboard. The reviewed platform is hosted with an EU-data-location claim; contract scope, subprocessors and any regulated requirements need account-specific confirmation. No self-hosted distribution or open-source license was established.
steps.zh: 从一份问卷和一个决策开始，列出所需 CRM、HR 或支持背景。确认具体连接器和数据权限，不要假定所有来源包含。测试分支、一份已知回答和共享看板访问。所读平台为托管服务，并宣称欧盟数据位置；合同范围、分处理者与监管要求需按账户确认。未建立自托管发行或开源许可。

items.en: Netigate advertises analysis in more than twenty languages; that is not a verified list of administration-interface languages or equally accurate sentiment performance across languages. This may fit cross-team feedback programs; a basic poll may need less configuration. A website feedback report is also not a complete view of every visitor. Validate translation, theme labels, missing-source alerts and connector failure behavior before relying on automatic prioritization. Recovery SLAs and independent AI accuracy were not tested.
items.zh: Netigate 宣传分析二十多种语言，这不是管理界面语言清单，也不能证明不同语言情绪分析准确性相同。它可适合跨团队反馈项目，基础投票可能不需这么多配置。网站反馈报告也不是每位访客的完整视图。依赖自动优先级前应验证翻译、主题标签、缺失来源提醒和连接器失败。恢复 SLA 及独立 AI 准确性未测试。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The pricing page starts at €7,000/year billed annually and includes onboarding and a customer-success team. It says users, responses and projects are unlimited, but also says pricing considers usage, response volume, AI functionality, integrations and business units or touchpoints. Interpret unlimited as an advertised capacity policy, not evidence that every configuration costs €7,000. AI availability varies by package. No lasting free plan or defined free-trial term was established; request a quote for the actual program.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 定价页每年 7,000 欧元起、按年计费，包含入门支持和客户成功团队。它称用户、回答及项目无限，同时说明价格考虑用量、回答量、AI、集成及业务单元或触点。应把无限理解为宣传容量政策，不能据此认为所有配置都只需 7,000 欧元。AI 可用性随组合变化。未建立长期免费档或确定试用条件，应按实际项目询价。

sections.title_en: Connect a survey trend to an owned improvement
sections.title_zh: 把问卷趋势连接到有负责人的改进
sections.en: For a proposed onboarding program, trigger a consistent short survey at a defined milestone, bring in permitted account context and compare themes across cohorts. Read comments behind an AI theme, identify an owner and record the follow-up before checking later feedback. A rise in NPS or CSAT does not alone prove the change caused a business outcome. Keep question wording, sampling and timing stable enough for meaningful comparison.
sections.zh: 入门体验项目可在明确里程碑触发一致短问卷，加入获准账户背景并比较不同群体主题。阅读 AI 主题对应评论，指定负责人并记录跟进，再检查后续反馈。NPS 或 CSAT 上升本身不证明改动导致业务结果。应尽量固定题目措辞、抽样和时机，以便有意义地比较。
